title: Swirl stIOTA (IOTA L1) — cap-less rebalance* surface, no unprivileged extraction
closed_reasons: cap-less rebalance/rebalance_from_validator/rabalance_overstaked move funds only from validators to pool.pending and immediately re-stake via stake_pool(); no recipient parameter, no caller payout (devInspect from random sender: success, no IOTA credited to sender)

every value-paying or config entry point requires OwnerCap (0x024b8ee182db98e727c4ceca0c5c7202e92933dd96d2a92c38a28eaecb632f52 -> 0x119191cd04c303b5cd872868a1898fe205c1eb9eaee9fb97c1ee87c943e40066) or OperatorCap (0xa78c4b44ea49620200994ba70712074e73675c4bb64989f35bb09dae6f178a5e -> 0x12e6e7b62250a5eb6bc0a8021fb9cf9635ebcbe433cdc2643fc315708f4e18d1); v9 collect_fee is a deprecated stub that always aborts 911, and the live payout path collect_fee_new/collect_fee_non_entry requires &OwnerCap (devInspect: abort 911 from foreign sender)

old package versions v1-v7 remain deployed but are version-gated out: assert_version accepts pool.version in {N-1,N}, live pool.version=9 accepts only v9 {8,9}; no cap-less unguarded mutator exists in any version
share math floors both ways (from_shares(to_shares(C)) = C - 1 nano); min_stake 1 IOTA blocks the min-1-share edge
no MintCap/TreasuryCap object: cert::mint is public(friend), only native_pool::stake can mint

caveats: cap-holder addresses are AddressOwner objects on RPC; whether they are native multisigs could not be verified from public RPC (admin-key compromise would be a P-class risk, not E-U)
no public indexer available for full-chain object enumeration; other Swirl custody objects not found via version-chain events, docs, or DefiLlama adapter (which reads exactly this NativePool)
USD figures use DefiLlama coingecko:iota price $0.05227973819565595 at ts 1791597174; token amounts exact at checkpoint 201,819,434 / epoch 522
devInspect simulates against latest state and never commits; no mainnet transaction was signed or submitted
one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract $0 live: Swirl's cap-less rebalance* functions are callable by anyone but only move the pool's own funds validator->pending->re-stake with no caller payout, while every payout/admin path requires OwnerCap/OperatorCap; only latent risk is a <=$612 pending-exclusion scenario needing >$700k capital plus an external trigger
